description: Defines a template class TimerType with nested classes for scheduling timed callbacks, including thread management and event handling, as well as a WatchDogType class for thread-based watchdog timers.

classes.name: TimerType
classes.description: A template class for scheduling timed callbacks with thread management and event synchronization.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::TimedInfo
classes.description: Holds scheduled time and content for timer callbacks.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a callback at a specific time with content.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific content entry is scheduled.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers a callback at a specific time with content.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a scheduled callback with specific content.

methods.name: NextTrigger
methods.description: Returns the time of the next scheduled trigger.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending scheduled callbacks.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the timer thread.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Main processing loop for timer thread, handling scheduled callbacks.
